caption: The drawing depicts an architectural structure that appears to be an altar or similar religious element, rendered with colored pencils in shades of reddish-brown, blue, and gray on an off-white background. The central feature is a rectangular niche or alcove bordered by a decorative arch with a cross at its apex and an ornate design highlighted in.blue and brown. This arch is supported by two thick reddish-brown columns, each capped with blue. Above the columns are two symmetrical archways trimmed with alternating reddish-brown and white segments, further outlined in blue and embellished with a pattern of short lines radiating outward. The base of the structure is adorned with a diamond-patterned panel of alternating reddish-brown and white tiles, bordered in blue, giving it a checkerboard appearance. On either side of the base, there are small shields or partitions topped with small crosses and lined along the edge with blue. Off to the left, a circular object ringed with spikes and a downward-pointing triangular shape is depicted, appearing to hang above a small stand. The overall composition is symmetrical along a central vertical axis and features a minimal background.
title: Wall Painting and Niche: Restoration Drawing
